w is hit and becomes source 2-list X; every z_h is anticomplete to a1,a2 and remains residual Y0.

symbolic_P7_certificate.conclusion: These seven vertices induce P7. Therefore the frozen inverse Golovach candidate is not P7-free.

gate_verdict.exact_blocker: The X0 anchor incidence needed to realize arbitrary a-type selector base lists creates an induced P7 with the seed/source-type edge and three inverse selector components.
gate_verdict.importance: Pure selector normal-form hardness does not automatically lift to the exact CSZ source domain; source-compatible fixed-color/base-list provenance is structurally constrained by P7-freeness.

no_repair_policy.statement: No anchor replacement, gadget modification, extra chords, or mutation of J_I was attempted after the first failure.
